editorial:
Imagine you are just a regular college student hanging out with your best friend, trying to find a date and finally lose your virginity. That is exactly where Luke and Roger find themselves. Everything seems normal until Luke notices something weird about the girls on campus. He starts to realize that these pretty women are not actually human, but are something much more dangerous. It feels like a typical teen movie at first, but it quickly turns into a creepy game of cat and mouse that keeps you guessing about who is real and who is a fake.

You will probably enjoy the fast pace and the way it mixes humor with scary moments. While some of the special effects look a bit dated, the suspense makes up for it. It is perfect for a movie night with friends when you want something easy and fun. If you want to see it, try renting it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you love collecting movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this hidden gem. Just make sure you watch it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video if you have the option to get the best picture quality.
endingExplained: You find out the girls are actually alien clones created to harvest human DNA. In the final showdown, Luke discovers the hive where the clones are made. He manages to fight back and destroy the alien leader, which stops the clones from taking over. The movie ends with the threat gone, though it leaves you wondering if every pretty girl on campus is actually safe or if some clones are still hiding in plain sight.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves B-movie horror and alien twists.
